states: fork, fork+1, fork+32, fork+33, end-1, end; shared fork measured once
relative_scale: full-training layer RMS at common fork; fixed across arms/states
unit: feature for MLP/Transformer, channel for CNN; all valid sample/spatial/token positions form rows
inactive_unit: max absolute activation over every covered row <= threshold
weak_unit: unit RMS <= threshold; distinct from inactive on every row
precision: original FP32 forward; FP64 sums and per-unit moments; exact integer zero/count summaries
training: no optimizer updates; saved states only; hooked versus plain forward/backward qualification
hardware: owned Spark; notebook available; no Runpod
